balanced_small.title: A normal operating week
balanced_small.situation: A small synthetic portfolio has room between commitments. Start by checking that every home can finish on time.
balanced_small.trigger: No disruption is applied in this healthy baseline.
balanced_small.what_went_wrong: Nothing failed. This scenario is the control case used to confirm that the undisrupted plan is healthy.
unavailable_resources: None — every crew-day, inventory receipt, and appointment window remains available.
balanced_small.question: Does the schedule leave enough room for routine operational variation?
what_to_watch: On-time commitments and spare crew capacity
The separate install and battery visits
balanced_small.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
balanced_small.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

tight_feasible.title: Find the last safe margin
tight_feasible.situation: A busy portfolio shares a tightly loaded battery crew. The original commitments are achievable.
tight_feasible.trigger: The busiest battery crew-day is removed in this modeled stress test.
tight_feasible.what_went_wrong: Battery crew BA cannot work on Tuesday, June 5, removing a fully planned battery crew-day from an already tight schedule.
unavailable_resources: All battery-installation minutes assigned to that crew-day
tight_feasible.question: Can the team recover without exceeding its remaining capacity?
what_to_watch: Battery crew utilization before the deadline
Late or deferred work after capacity is removed
tight_feasible.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
tight_feasible.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

crew_out_recoverable.title: Protect commitments after a crew absence
crew_out_recoverable.situation: The undisrupted schedule has assigned install and battery crews to every synthetic home.
crew_out_recoverable.trigger: A modeled absence removes the busiest install crew-day.
crew_out_recoverable.what_went_wrong: Install crew IA is absent on Thursday, June 7, so every electrical install booked to that crew-day loses its assigned capacity.
unavailable_resources: The install-skilled capacity on that crew-day
crew_out_recoverable.question: Which recovery protects commitments with the least appointment disruption?
what_to_watch: Directly affected installs and their battery visits
No action versus rebalancing or useful extra capacity
crew_out_recoverable.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
crew_out_recoverable.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

inventory_delay_recoverable.title: The battery delivery slips
inventory_delay_recoverable.situation: Battery receipts arrive in dated batches sized to the healthy plan.
inventory_delay_recoverable.trigger: The first incoming receipt moves to the business day after its earliest booked battery visit.
inventory_delay_recoverable.what_went_wrong: The June 4 delivery of B13 batteries is delayed until June 7, so battery appointments scheduled before the replacement receipt no longer have inventory.
unavailable_resources: Replacement B13 units are unavailable until 2018-06-07
inventory_delay_recoverable.question: Can battery visits be reshuffled around the actual receipt date?
what_to_watch: Battery visits displaced by the delayed receipt
Skills on any temporary capacity offered
inventory_delay_recoverable.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
inventory_delay_recoverable.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

readiness_appointment.title: Respect when homes can host work
readiness_appointment.situation: The healthy schedule assumes each synthetic home is ready and available for its visits.
readiness_appointment.trigger: One home becomes ready later and its battery visit receives an exact appointment window.
readiness_appointment.what_went_wrong: Home W-01 is not ready until June 6, and its battery visit W-01-B can now occur only on June 7. The original timing is no longer legal.
unavailable_resources: Customer access for visit W-01-B on every date except 2018-06-07
readiness_appointment.question: What can still be achieved while honoring both availability constraints?
what_to_watch: Readiness date and the explicit appointment window
No work before readiness or outside the window
readiness_appointment.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
readiness_appointment.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

skill_cluster_bottleneck.title: The right crew, in the right territory
skill_cluster_bottleneck.situation: Install and battery crews are assigned to separate North and South territories.
skill_cluster_bottleneck.trigger: The busiest battery crew-day is removed; the other territory still has its crew.
skill_cluster_bottleneck.what_went_wrong: North battery crew BN is unavailable on Friday, June 8. The South crew remains staffed but is not qualified for the affected North territory.
unavailable_resources: No eligible cross-territory battery crew for the North cluster
skill_cluster_bottleneck.question: Can the affected territory recover without borrowing an ineligible crew?
what_to_watch: Crew skill and allowed territory
Useful eligible capacity rather than unsafe substitutions
skill_cluster_bottleneck.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
skill_cluster_bottleneck.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

two_visit_cascade.title: An install delay reaches the battery visit
two_visit_cascade.situation: Each synthetic home needs an electrical install before its battery appointment, with a two-business-day gap.
two_visit_cascade.trigger: An install appointment moves beyond its original battery date.
two_visit_cascade.what_went_wrong: Electrical install W-01-I is moved to June 8. Its dependent battery visit can no longer keep the earlier booking because the required two-business-day gap would be violated.
unavailable_resources: Customer access for install W-01-I on every date except 2018-06-08
The original downstream slot for battery visit W-01-B
two_visit_cascade.question: Which downstream battery commitment must change to preserve precedence?
what_to_watch: The moved install and its dependent battery visit
Business-day gaps, reschedules and missed deadlines
two_visit_cascade.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
two_visit_cascade.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

locked_infeasible.title: A promise that cannot move
locked_infeasible.situation: The healthy plan is fully booked and every appointment is locked.
locked_infeasible.trigger: An install crew-day with locked bookings becomes unavailable.
locked_infeasible.what_went_wrong: Install crew IB is unavailable on Tuesday, June 5, but visits assigned to that crew-day are locked and cannot legally move. The promises and available capacity now conflict.
unavailable_resources: Alternative appointment dates for the affected locked visits
locked_infeasible.question: Can any option honor the locks, or must the operator revise the assumptions?
what_to_watch: Infeasibility instead of silently moving a lock
Disabled approval when no feasible plan exists
locked_infeasible.success_criterion: Recognize the infeasible promise; do not approve or silently relax a locked visit.
locked_infeasible.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

late_overflow.title: Finish the work after promises slip
late_overflow.situation: The original plan finishes inside the commitment window; extra business days are available afterward.
late_overflow.trigger: The battery receipt moves beyond all original deadlines.
late_overflow.what_went_wrong: The June 4 delivery of B13 batteries is delayed until June 11, after the original commitment window. Battery work cannot start on time even though overflow crew capacity exists.
late_overflow.question: How much can be completed in overflow, and which appointments become late?
what_to_watch: Late jobs completed in the overflow days
No inventory use before receipt and honest reschedule counts
late_overflow.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
late_overflow.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.

value_sensitive.title: Compare commissioning order
value_sensitive.situation: The healthy plan meets every commitment. A shared capacity stress test exposes choices between otherwise legal recovery schedules.
value_sensitive.trigger: The same busy battery crew-day is removed for both policy comparisons, opening alternative legal commissioning dates.
value_sensitive.what_went_wrong: Battery crew BA is unavailable on Wednesday, June 13. Its battery jobs must be reassigned, creating several legal schedules with different commissioning dates and modeled value.
unavailable_resources: The battery-installation capacity assigned to that crew-day
value_sensitive.question: Does earlier commissioning increase modeled operating margin under identical constraints?
what_to_watch: Assignment differences between objective policies
Historical-price modeled margin, not forecast profit
value_sensitive.success_criterion: Compare only validated outcomes that respect inventory, skills, territories, readiness, appointments and visit precedence.
value_sensitive.truth_label: Synthetic installation portfolio; modeled operational disruptions and costs. Energy values use observed 2018 prices as a hindsight benchmark. No real customer records or observed weather event are used in this story.
